messages:
Nora (Design): Quick microcopy review for the Data retention tooltip on the Logs page. Current text: `Logs are retained`  too vague. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/logs-retention
Dev (PM): Yup, customers keep asking how long and whether exported data is affected. We should avoid legal-sounding language but be precise.
Sam (Copy): Draft options:
1) `Logs are retained for up to 30 days.`
2) `Logs are typically retained for 30 days; retention may vary by plan.`
3) `Most logs are kept for 30 days. Exported logs are not affected.`
Kai (Eng): Backend truth: logs are kept ~30 days for hosted accounts, Dedicated can change retention. Export pipeline pulls raw logs immediately and is unaffected.
Ivy (A11y): Accessibility notes: tooltip link should not be just "Learn more". Use descriptive link text. Also keep the visible tooltip short (one line) and provide a more detailed panel for screen readers.
Nora (Design): Visual constraint: the tooltip can fit ~80 characters. We need a short line + a descriptive link.
Sam (Copy): Combining accuracy + brevity:
- Tooltip: "Logs are typically kept 30 days; export unaffected."
- Link text: "See how retention works and export options"
Dev (PM): I like that. It tells the user two things: rough retention and that export isn't blocked. But "typically" covers Dedicated differences.
Kai (Eng): One implementation caveat: the phrase "export unaffected" might imply exports bypass RBAC/Privacy mode. We should avoid that. Maybe: "export pipeline runs immediately"? That's technical.
Ivy (A11y): For screen readers, make the tooltip trigger have aria-label: "Logs retention info" and set the link aria-label to the full visible link text. Also ensure the detailed panel is reachable via keyboard.
Sam (Copy): Revised concise bundle to be safe:
- Tooltip: "Logs are typically kept 30 days; exported logs begin processing immediately."
- Link: "See how retention and exports work"
- Tooltip trigger aria-label: "Logs retention info"
- Link aria-label: "See how retention and exports work"
Nora (Design): Slight wording tweak to keep it non-technical: change "begin processing" to "are processed immediately"  shorter.
Sam (Copy): Final text:
- Tooltip: "Logs are typically kept 30 days; exported logs are processed immediately."
- Link: "See how retention and exports work"
Ivy (A11y): Approve. Also recommend adding a hidden heading at top of the detailed panel like "Logs retention and export details" so screen reader users get context.
Kai (Eng): I'll implement the tooltip copy + add aria attrs. Will coordinate with Product to ensure Dedicated plan language links to plan docs.
Dev (PM): Great. Nora, please update Figma. Sam, add this to /docs/microcopy/tooltips.md and include the SR notes.
Nora (Design): On it. I'll push the figma update and attach the alt text.
